Title: Azure Database for MariaDB—Reserved capacity is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MariaDB reserved capacity is now available to reserve compute power for your existing and future MariaDB servers. The new pricing option enables you to save up to 51 percent compared to the regular pay-as-you-go payment option for your MariaDB server vCores for a one-year period. Read more about this announcement in our service documentation.

For more information, see the Azure Database for MariaDB pricing page.
